title: EXPLAIN 文本解析与执行计划健康度判定
expected_output:
=== 解析后的执行计划 ===
  表 o    type=ref     key=idx_user    rows=200    Extra=Using index condition
  表 u    type=eq_ref  key=PRIMARY     rows=1      Extra=NULL

=== 逐表健康度 ===
  表 o    type=ref     评级=健康
  表 u    type=eq_ref  评级=健康

=== Extra 关键信号 ===
  表 o    Using index condition    -> 索引下推 ICP, 仍可能回表

整体最差 type 得分 = 3 -> 可接受
核对: 是否 hit 期望索引 = True
code:
# EXPLAIN 文本表格解析 + 判定是否命中期望索引
RAW = (
    "id | select_type | table | type  | possible_keys | key        | key_len | ref   | rows   | Extra\n"
    "1  | SIMPLE      | o     | ref   | idx_user      | idx_user   | 8       | const | 200    | Using index condition\n"
    "1  | SIMPLE      | u     | eq_ref| PRIMARY       | PRIMARY    | 8       | o.uid | 1      | NULL\n"
)

def parse(text):
    lines = [l for l in text.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()]
    header = [c.strip() for c in lines[0].split("|")]
    rows = []
    for line in lines[1:]:
        cells = [c.strip() for c in line.split("|")]
        rows.append(dict(zip(header, cells)))
    return header, rows

RANK = {"system": 0, "const": 1, "eq_ref": 2, "ref": 3,
        "range": 4, "index": 5, "ALL": 6}

header, rows = parse(RAW)
print("=== 解析后的执行计划 ===")
for r in rows:
    print("  表 %-4s type=%-7s key=%-11s rows=%-6s Extra=%s"
          % (r["table"], r["type"], r["key"], r["rows"], r["Extra"]))
print()
print("=== 逐表健康度 ===")
worst = 0
for r in rows:
    score = RANK.get(r["type"], 9)
    worst = max(worst, score)
    level = "健康" if score <= 3 else ("需留意" if score == 4 else "需优化")
    print("  表 %-4s type=%-7s 评级=%s" % (r["table"], r["type"], level))
print()
print("=== Extra 关键信号 ===")
flags = {
    "Using index": "覆盖索引, 不回表(最好)",
    "Using index condition": "索引下推 ICP, 仍可能回表",
    "Using filesort": "发生了额外排序, 需优化 ORDER BY",
    "Using temporary": "用了临时表, 常见于 GROUP BY / DISTINCT 无索引",
    "Using where": "存储引擎返回后再过滤",
}
for r in rows:
    tokens = [t.strip() for t in (r["Extra"] or "").split(",") if t.strip()]
    for tok in tokens:
        for key, desc in flags.items():
            if tok == key:      # 精确相等, 避免 "Using index" 误配 "Using index condition"
                print("  表 %-4s %-24s -> %s" % (r["table"], key, desc))
print()
print("整体最差 type 得分 = %d -> %s" % (worst, "可接受" if worst <= 4 else "必须优化"))
print("核对: 是否 hit 期望索引 = %s" % all("ALL" != r["type"] for r in rows))
